name: UltraTech Cement Ltd

ledger.quote: We are expecting to complete the brand transition for these acquired assets, not later than June '26.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: June 2026 target passed without management updating on the brand transition status in the latest call.

ledger.quote: Our expansion plans are going on full swing, and we will complete or exit this financial year with 200 million tons of capacity under our belt.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Reached domestic capacity of 204.7 million tons after commissioning 4.6 million tons in September 2026.
ledger.evidence: We commissioned 4.6 million tons of capacity in the month of September, taking our domestic cement capacity to 204.7 million tons

ledger.quote: We expect delivery to start from January '26, and the plant should get commissioned in time for Q3 production launch.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.target: Q3 production launch for cables and wires
ledger.verdict: Launched Ultravolt wires and cables business on September 3, 2026.
ledger.evidence: On 3rd September this year, we launched our Wires and Cables business under the brand Ultravolt.

ledger.quote: However, by the time we complete the expansion, which is January March 28 or by the time the expansions are fully operational, the ICL assets will start generating EBITDA per ton of INR1,000 and a net debt EBITDA of around 0.5x.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Target to generate INR1,000 EBITDA per ton for ICL assets is set for Q4 FY28.

ledger.quote: Amit, so we are now sticking our program to reach about 240 - 245 million tons, which will get completed by fiscal '29.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Capacity target of 240 to 245 million tons is scheduled for completion by fiscal 2029.

ledger.quote: We will reach about 65% of green power by the end of our current phase of growth.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.by_when: end of current phase of growth
ledger.verdict: Green power share target of 65% is for the current growth phase; reached 47% currently.
ledger.evidence: 47% of our power needs were met from non-fossil fuel sources.

ledger.quote: I will have about INR10,000 crores minimum per year, outgo.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Spent INR5,882 crores capex in H1 FY27, maintaining full-year target around INR10,000 crores.

ledger.quote: I believe and I'm very confident that we'll reach the mark of 1x and be in 0.8, 0.9x net debt EBITDA by the end of this fiscal year.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Ended FY26 at 0.94x net debt to EBITDA, slightly above the target range of 0.8-0.9x.
ledger.evidence: March end, we were at 0.94x net debt EBITDA. We are at 1.26x net debt EBITDA at the end of September '26.

ledger.quote: So, we should have approximately 8 to 9 million tons more coming in this quarter. And the balance,12 million tons in fiscal '27 and then balance remaining will be in '28.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.target: Add 8-9 million tons in Q4 and 12 million tons in FY27
ledger.verdict: Expansion roadmap adding 12 million tons in FY27 and remainder in FY28 is ongoing.

ledger.quote: We shall give an exact quantification and financial impact with our annual results for the year.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.target: Quantification of efficiency impact with annual results
ledger.verdict: Promised financial quantification of efficiency impacts with annual results was not addressed in the latest call.

ledger.quote: I would expect further generation of up to INR500 crores minimum, which we should be able to get.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.target: Generate minimum INR500 crores from non-core assets
ledger.verdict: Target of generating INR500 crores minimum from non-core assets remains open without explicit deadline.

ledger.quote: Yes. So '27 or first half of '28, so just giving us a flexibility of some delays.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.by_when: FY27 or first half of FY28
ledger.verdict: Green energy target completion by FY27 or first half of FY28 remains ongoing.

ledger.quote: We have committed to add a further 37 million tons, which will take us over 242.5 million tons in a phased manner by fiscal '28.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Capacity target exceeding 242.5 million tons is planned for completion by fiscal 2028.

ledger.quote: We have committed to reach about 85% of our power requirements from green energy by the end of fiscal 2030, and we are very confident of reaching that position.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Target to reach 85% green power share by fiscal 2030 remains pending.

ledger.quote: We expect a sustainable volume growth of 7% to 8% per annum.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Achieved volume growth of 13.8% in Q2 FY27, exceeding the 7% to 8% target.
ledger.evidence: Our growth of 13.8% this quarter is comfortably ahead, which means that our presence in the market is continuously increasing.

ledger.quote: We'll maintain our leverage below 1x year after year after meeting our growth capex.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Target to keep net debt to EBITDA below 1x for FY27 is ongoing; stands at 1.26x in Q2.
ledger.evidence: We are at 1.26x net debt EBITDA at the end of September '26. But by the end of March, I will be below 1x net debt to EBITDA.

ledger.quote: We have targeted to reach about 1.54x. That road map is already there and let's see how things shape up beyond that.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Roadmap to achieve 1.54x clinker conversion ratio by fiscal 2028 is ongoing.

ledger.quote: We'll take our consolidated capacity beyond 242 million tons with grey cement capacity to reach 212.7 million tons by the end of fiscal '27 and further balance to be completed in the next year.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Target to reach 212.7 million tons grey cement capacity by end of FY27 remains ongoing.

ledger.quote: We are targeting double-digit volume growth this year.
ledger.speaker: Atul Daga
ledger.verdict: Delivered 13.8% volume growth in Q2 FY27, maintaining double-digit volume growth trajectory.
ledger.evidence: Our growth of 13.8% this quarter is comfortably ahead, which means that our presence in the market is continuously increasing.

open.quote: We are on track to reach 240 million tons of capacity as planned without any surprises.
open.speaker: Kailash C. Jhanwar

open.quote: And the balance will get spent in the next maybe 2 quarters.
open.speaker: Atul Daga

open.quote: By the end of March, I will be below 1x net debt to EBITDA.
open.speaker: Atul Daga

open.quote: We will come with our detailed plans before the end of this financial year.
open.speaker: Atul Daga

open.quote: We will not stop before 10,000 stores, which should happen in the next 3 years which is 28-29, we should be reaching about 10,000 stores.
open.speaker: Atul Daga

open.quote: What I can promise is that we will manage it much better than anybody else under the sun.
open.speaker: Kailash C. Jhanwar

open.quote: With that, capacity of 78,000 tons of copper consumption on an annualized basis, we are already number two in our space.
open.speaker: Atul Daga

open.quote: Remaining power and control cable lines will be commissioned through the second half.
open.speaker: Kailash C. Jhanwar

read: Management demonstrates dependable execution on operational targets, including capacity commissioning, product launches, and volume growth expectations. Slight minor variances occur on leverage milestones, though capital projects stay largely on schedule.
questions: What is the completion status of the brand transition program targeted for June 2026?
Why did net debt to EBITDA finish at 0.94x at FY26 end versus 0.8-0.9x guided?
Can management provide the financial quantification of efficiency impacts previously promised with annual results?
bull: Domestic capacity reached 204.7 million tons after commissioning 4.6 million tons in September 2026.
Achieved volume growth of 13.8% in Q2 FY27, beating the 7% to 8% target.
Successfully launched Ultravolt wires and cables business on September 3, 2026.
bear: Net debt to EBITDA increased to 1.26x at end of September 2026 from 0.94x in March.
Management provided no update on the brand transition completion targeted for June 2026.
Operating profit margin contracted to 16% in Sep 2026 from 20% in Jun 2026.
